5. Run the program. For more information, see Functions for Scheduling Program Runs.

You can postprocess the dunning proposal. To do this, check the application log of the dunning proposal run. For example,
you can exclude individual dunning notices from the dunning activity run by reversing the relevant dunning notices. Or you
can remove dunning blocks that have been set in error.

After you have completed postprocessing, delete the relevant dunning proposal run in the menu under |}Environment
Delete Dunning Proposal “. Then start a new dunning proposal run. You can start the dunning activity run directly
afterwards by setting the Trigger Activity Run indicator, or you can start it manually in a separate step.

1 Note

The dunning proposal run checks whether there is a dunning notice that has not been executed for a business partner in
the system. If this is the case, the dunning proposal run does not create a new dunning notice and issues a warning in
the application log.

The dunning proposal run considers dunning reductions that result from dispute cases in SAP Dispute Management,
for example. The system distributes the dunning reductions to the dunning groups in event 0335 and reduces the

dunning balance by this amount. SAP provides the sample function module FKK_SAMPLE_0335_DISPUTE for the
deduction of amounts from dispute cases. Define the module as an installation-specific function module for event 0335.

Dunning Activity Runs

Use

Once you have executed the dunning proposal run successfully, start the second subprocess of the dunning run — the dunning
activity run.

Prerequisites

1. You have successfully completed the dunning proposal run.

2. You have carried out the preparations required for creating dunning letters (see Creating Printed Records).

Key Features

The dunning activity run determines and runs the dunning activities defined in the dunning procedures and dunning levels. A
dunning activity run relates only to those overdue items determined in a dunning proposal run.

If the dunning activity run carried out a dunning activity successfully, it sets the print date in the dunning proposal. The print date
is the same as the run date.

If errors occurred during the execution of the dunning activities run, the system only sets the print date in some of the dunning
headers. If the cause of the error is in the dunning proposal, you have to reverse the dunning notices concerned. If the cause of the
error is in the dunning activity run, you have to correct the error and then start the dunning activity run again for this dunning
